headline: Brazil Defines Limits for International Transfer of Carbon Credits
summary: The Brazilian government, under President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has defined regulatory limits for the international transfer of carbon credits, formalizing a national framework.
why: Carbon credit regulations impact environmental markets, project developers, and corporate compliance strategies under global climate pacts.
